prompts.cast-01:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: one reusable four-pose character sprite sheet for Ihaero Studio, adult accessible legal explanation materials.
Primary request: one fictional adult character repeated consistently in FOUR poses. This is ONE character's pose sheet, not four different characters. Simple animation-style image or illustration, warm restrained colors, clean dark outlines, clear eyes nose and mouth, respectful adult proportions.
Composition/framing: landscape sheet with exactly FOUR equal-width invisible columns in a single horizontal row, with generous completely transparent gutters. Exactly one isolated waist-up figure per column, entire head and all hands in frame. No artwork may cross a quarter-width column boundary. All four figures have identical face, hair, age, outfit and proportions. Torso angled slightly toward the right, face visible. Keep the same scale and waist baseline in all columns.
Poses, left to right: (1) listen/neutral: relaxed hands down and attentive neutral expression; (2) request/explain: one open palm gently extended toward the right, calm face, no pointing; (3) refuse: one raised open palm politely signaling stop toward the right, calm face, no angry expression; (4) inspect/consider: eyes lowered slightly toward their own open hands at waist level, considering information, no object held.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, no checkerboard drawn into the image. No panel frames, labels, text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, watermarks, scenery, furniture, props, money, documents or extra people. No grounded shadows. The four poses must remain clearly separated.
Subject: Adult with an oval face, short straight dark hair with a side part, clean-shaven, teal collared overshirt and navy trousers.
